An '''Iotran''' had a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] placed on her at some point prior to [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] caught the [[Iotran/Legends|Iotran]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rivvidu]] and kept her [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]], the ''[[Silver Speeder]]'', as a prize.
